title: Decide whether CodeNav.GitTests keeps xUnit diagnostic messages enabled
outcome: The Git test runner either disables diagnosticMessages or documents why the extra permanent runner output is intentional.
acceptance: diagnosticMessages is false, or the CodeNav.GitTests project comment records why it remains enabled
